seed_note: N1 draws nothing; the seed is the N2 mixture's and bootstrap's

nesz_model.primary: NESZ_X = nes0_coeff_0 of channel X, constant over the swath (-31.5 dB LH)
nesz_model.sensitivity: NESZ_X(j) = nes0_coeff_0 + nes0_coeff_1 j, j the SLC range-sample index (the label does not state the variable; this is the one that keeps the model positive over the swath)
nesz_model.snr: SNR_X = boxcar'd calibrated intensity / NESZ_X; min SNR = min(SNR_H, SNR_V), dB

noise_correction: C_HH - n_H, C_VV - n_V on the 21-look, 5 x 5 boxcar'd covariance; C_HV untouched; cells with a non-positive corrected power are dropped; Stokes, R, DOP and N_hat re-formed
floors: cells with min SNR below 3 or 6 dB excluded from the rule, the IUT and N_hat's window
window: full = every sample of the 5 x 5 boxcar window non-zero in both channels (before the boxcar)

v20_reconciliation.seed_note: draws nothing; every rate is a count with a Wilson interval

radiometric_scales.snr_denominator: the channel's label nes0_coeff_0 (LH 7.038e-4, LV 6.065e-4; -31.5 / -32.2 dB), used as given: sigma0-type, no sin(theta) applied; the calibrated intensity it divides is l = DN^2 sin(theta_label) / (K G^2), i.e. sigma0-scale with the label's scalar sin(theta) = 0.342
radiometric_scales.subtracted_noise: the same number, subtracted from C_HH and C_VV of that calibrated coherency
radiometric_scales.consistent_with_the_data: NO at face value (reading R1): the corrected matrix is not positive semidefinite in the fraction of cells reported in alpha_scan, far above the fraction at SNR > 10 dB where the correction is negligible; the excess vanishes at alpha <= about 0.5

readings.R1: nes0 is sigma0 as labelled; noise in the calibrated scale = nes0 (alpha = 1)
readings.R2: nes0 is sigma0 at the local incidence of the geometry file; alpha = sin(20 deg) / sin(theta_local(j))
readings.R3: nes0 is beta0; noise in the calibrated (sigma0) scale = nes0 sin(20 deg), alpha = 0.342

scan.label: sigma0 at local incidence, reading R2
sigma0 at local incidence, reading R2

reading_R3_beta0.note: a constant shift of -10 log10(sin theta_label) = +4.66 dB; the difference is unchanged
a constant shift of -10 log10(sin theta_label) = +4.66 dB; the difference is unchanged

fixes: noise scaled by the window's valid-sample fraction
non-PSD cells projected and kept (left out of the N-hat windows) instead of dropped
